Why I built it

28 people. 30 brand partners.
The ceiling was my own review time.

Manual research

Pulling ad data, checking competitors, writing reports by hand. Hours per client, every week.

Growth bottleneck

Every brand needed my personal review and feedback. My hours capped how many brands we could take.

Too many errors

Copy-pasted numbers, inconsistent report formats, things slipping through QC.

What I built

One AI room per client.
One portal for every output.

How it works

Chat in. Files out.

01 · DIRECT

Request in Telegram

Team gives direction in the client's room. Plain language, Bahasa or English.

02 · PULL

AI pulls live data

Straight from the source, no manual export.

Meta Graph APITikTok AdsShopee CPASAds LibraryFathom
03 · PRODUCE

Output, same format

Reports, briefs, competitor intel, meeting notes, assessments. Consistent every time.

04 · PUSH

Saved to the portal

Download as a client touchpoint, or feed it back to AI to brainstorm.

Every output becomes context for the next request. The knowledge compounds instead of getting lost in chat.

    How it was made

    I drew the mindmap. My team made it happen.

    My part: the instructions, the what and the why. The BAIK team built the how: three layers.

    01 · INTERFACE

    Telegram

    Group with Topics1 topic = 1 client
    Bot as adminReads every request in plain language
    Replies in the topicStatus, time taken, summary, link
    request
    02 · BRAIN

    AI agent on a server

    RouterTopic ID → that client's folder
    Client memory folderBrief · KPI & budget · competitor watchlist · past outputs
    Agent + SOPYour playbooks as instructions: report format, winning-ad rules, devil's-advocate checks
    Meta Graph APITikTok AdsCPASAds LibraryIG scraperFathom
    file
    03 · OUTPUT

    Portal

    Files per clientDated markdown, never overwritten
    Rendered pagesCategories, NEW / DRAFT, download
    Access controlEach person sees only their clients
    Client-facingHTML → Vercel, one link to share
    Every output goes back into the client folder and becomes context for the next request.
    What I learned
    “
    Make AI your devil's advocate.

    Ask it to push back, not to agree. It keeps us sharp.

    Not lazier. More diligent.

    AI took the grunt work. We now spend the saved hours on the 20% that drives 80% of results.

    Transparency builds trust

    The AI flags its own data discrepancies in the report, before the client has to ask.

    Closing

    Ads are an amplifier,
    not a savior.
    So is AI.

    Fundamentals first. Then let AI multiply them.
